notes: Taḥwīl: the first branch ends at حماد بن زيد; «جميعا عن عمرو بن دينار، عن ابن، عمر» is written once after both branches meet, so it is the shared tail. The comma inside «ابن، عمر» is kept as written.
«نحو حديث ابن عيينة» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group. The gloss «- رضى الله عنهما -» is left out.
